description.value: This McDonald's at Market Crossing is a full-service fast food location offering dine-in and drive-through service with the complete Canadian McDonald's menu including burgers, chicken, and McCafé beverages. Indoor seating provides a sheltered rest stop for cyclists passing through the commercial area, and the menu includes vegetarian and limited vegan options. It functions as a practical food resupply point on routes through the greater Vancouver area.
